sections.title: Do you need IELTS for Electrical Engineering in Switzerland?
sections.lead: Not necessarily so. Many bachelor’s programs are taught mainly in German or French, so proficiency in the relevant language may be required instead. Always check the language rules of the specific program.

sections.title: Are there bachelor’s programs in Electrical Engineering in Switzerland that are taught in English?
sections.lead: There are few full English taught options. Some universities do offer individual English-language modules or international study profiles, but German or French may still be required for the main bachelor’s program.

sections.title: What to do after Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering in Switzerland?
sections.lead: You can pursue further education or a career in electrical design, power systems, electronics, embedded systems, automation, telecommunications, and renewable energy. Your employment depends on your qualifications, experience, language skills and work authorization.
